title: Phase 2：規則 54 在寬度 4 的倍數的環上，暫態 (w−4)/2、週期 4（R2-C10 第一段）

R2-C10.proof: w ≡ 0 (mod 4): paper proof and Lean proof for all w ≥ 4 (rule54_mod4_zero); numeric check: (transient, period) by two implementations for w ≤ 1200; cell-by-cell cone/ether check by one implementation (w ≤ 1200) plus the critic's independent third implementation (w ≤ 1600). w ≡ 1, 2, 3 (mod 4): still only the finite Lean check 6 ≤ w ≤ 200 (DISC-0006).

novelty.note: No new searches in this record. The ether is the known rule-54 domain (Hanson–Crutchfield 1997, not re-read). The argument is elementary (light cone + ether). Not checked: arXiv, MathSciNet. The reused OEIS query (DISC-0006-S005) is the mixed four-class sequence; restricted to w ≡ 0 the transient is just the even numbers, so that query does not discriminate this case and is not a check of it. Still to check: Jen's cylindrical CA papers, Wolfram's finite-ring cycle tables, arXiv.
